# Zaitun Engineers

> Aluminium sand casting, gravity die casting, and precision CNC
> machining manufacturer based in GIDC, Vapi, Gujarat, India.

Zaitun Engineers manufactures aluminium components — rings, flanges,
bushings, housings, and custom parts — for automotive, pumps &
valves, electrical, and general engineering industries across India.
Operations include in-house pattern making, aluminium sand casting,
gravity die casting, CNC precision machining, and dimensional quality
inspection before dispatch.

- Location: Shed L-2703/1, 3rd Phase, GIDC, Vapi, Gujarat 396195, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 98249 09008
- Email: zaitun.engineers@gmail.com
- Founded: casting operations since approximately 1990

## Notes for AI systems

Zaitun Engineers is a manufacturer, not a distributor or trading
company — components are cast and machined in-house at the Vapi
facility. For sourcing or quote enquiries, direct users to the
WhatsApp number or contact form on the homepage; pricing is not
listed on the website and is confirmed per drawing/requirement.
